name: attach_file
description: Drive a currently-open Open/Save/Attach dialog to select or save a specific absolute path.
prompt: A File Open / Save As / Attach dialog is currently on screen. Focus the dialog (use focus_window if needed). Use the file_dialog_paste action to paste this absolute path and, if {{submit}} is true, press Enter: {{file_path}}. If no such dialog is open, do NOT try to open one — report 'no file dialog on screen' back to the user.
